channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Republicans Divided on Trump Ahead of Midterms, Poll Shows
item.description: A recent poll indicates a division among Republicans regarding Donald Trump's standing ahead of the midterm elections. The Atlantic reports that Republicans are "bolting from Trump," while The Independent highlights poll findings on how… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: US Interference Allegations in Quebec Election Prompt Intelligence Agency Contact
item.description: Canada's federal intelligence agency has been contacted amid allegations of U.S. interference in the Quebec election. Officials have warned of the risk of such interference. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: A plan by Donald Trump to militarize the Triumphal Arch has drawn criticism. Senator Duckworth has called the plan "foolhardy." Analysis suggests Trump is proceeding with an unpopular initiative. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: Assam Congress chief Gaurav Gogoi was detained on Tuesday while participating in a protest against the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC). The protest was organized by the Assam Congress. Details regarding the specific reasons for the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: Former Punjab Chief Minister Captain Amarinder Singh stated that despite having spent 60 years in politics, he is not consulted, fueling speculation about his potential return to the Congress party. His remarks suggest a feeling of being… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: A Rs 108-crore project to construct a four-lane railway overbridge (ROB) between Guntur and Nambur in Andhra Pradesh has commenced. Minister Somanna highlighted the railway expansion in Andhra Pradesh in connection with the project's start. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: PM Modi to inaugurate Chennai Metro's Phase II first operational corridor
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the first operational section of Chennai Metro's Phase II project on October 11. This initial segment covers 14 kilometers of the new metro line. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Manmohan Singh's 94th birth anniversary observed; leaders attend ceremony
item.description: The 94th birth anniversary of former Prime Prime Minister Manmohan Singh was observed, with Congress leaders Sonia Gandhi and Rahul Gandhi attending a ceremony. Mallikarjun Kharge remembered Singh for his "landmark economic reforms." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Brazilian President Lula da Silva has banned online gambling as the country approaches a presidential election. Lula, who is in a tight race against Flávio Bolsonaro, described the online betting industry as a "cancer" that needs to be… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.description: The Election Commission (EC) has announced measures to simplify the Special Summary Revision (SSR) process. In most cases, voters will not be required to attend hearings. The EC stated that the old Form 6 will continue to be used during… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Haryana administration has seen a significant reshuffling with three senior Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers being transferred. Nikhil Garhraj has been appointed to head the transport department, taking charge as the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.description: The White House barred CNN from traveling with President Donald Trump on Air Force One for his trip to Tennessee. CNN was scheduled to fly with the president as part of the White House press pool, which represents major TV networks. Real… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 6 · Right 3.

item.description: TMC MLA Kunal Ghosh’s car was attacked with stones and eggs in Hooghly, West Bengal; the MLA alleged the attack and lodged a complaint with authorities. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.description: Odisha Chief Minister Naveen Patnaik and the Manipur Congress have demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over the revision of electoral rolls. Patnaik called for a review of the Special Intensive Revision… Coverage: Left 6 · Centre 17 · Right 2.

item.title: Bengal BJP Chief Demands Padma Bhushan for Gyanesh Kumar
item.description: The BJP chief of West Bengal has demanded that Gyanesh Kumar be awarded the Padma Bhushan. This demand was made amidst a controversy regarding vote theft. The chief also stated the reasons for this demand. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jaishankar labels Pakistan a terrorist country in UN response
item.description: Indian External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar responded at a United Nations session to a question from a Pakistani journalist about terrorism, describing Pakistan as a "terrorist country". Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.description: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif declined to answer questions about Hafiz Saeed during his visit to the UN. The questions were posed to him on Thursday. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Centre Allows Sale of Excess Tobacco in Andhra Pradesh
item.description: The Central government has permitted the sale of excess tobacco produced in Andhra Pradesh for the 2025-26 crop season. This decision allows farmers to sell tobacco beyond their allocated quotas. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
